\section{Reproducibility and Implementation Details}
This appendix provides reproducibility details, additional diagnostics, and full model-comparison results generated by the code pipeline.
\subsection{Simulation and Numerical Controls}
Across Monte Carlo engines, the following implementation controls are used: daily variance cap $\sigma_t^2 \le 0.0025$, spread cap of 0.5 (5000 bps), and horizon mapping to 1y/3y/5y ($252/756/1260$ trading days). Antithetic variates are supported and enabled in selected production runs.
All appendix tables based on dated outputs are restricted to 2017+ observations.
